ticket.subject: Seriously??
ticket.body_text:
I am SO tired of getting a separate invoice email every single month. Twelve emails a year for the same thing!!! Is there really no way to pay once a year and get ONE invoice instead?? Honestly.

Tomasz

label_notes: tone_mismatch: angry tone, but it is a general question about switching to annual billing with no impact and no deadline, so billing P4 low.
